title: iHeartMedia Celebrates New Music from Anuel AA, HARDY, Kirk Franklin, Olivia Rodrigo, Thomas Rhett and Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK – November 6, 2026 –** iHeartMedia highlighted new music and artists alike recently with World Premieres and special programming.


Today, iHeartCountry celebrated **Thomas Rhett’s** new track “Be There In A Minute” with a World Premiere across iHeartCountry stations. Additionally, **Olivia Rodrigo’s** “Take Me Home (4 Christmas)” was featured in New Music Friday slots on iHeartRadio CHR stations.


On November 5, the **“iHeartRadio and TikTok LIVE Premiere with Anuel AA”** streamed LIVE on TikTok and exclusively previewed new music from Real Hasta La Muerte 2. Anuel AA also teased the release timing for the new album. To continue the celebration of the new album throughout the month **iHeartRadio will also broadcast the special on release day** , reviewing the new tracks and Anuel’s inspiration behind the album on iHeartRadio Spanish Mainstream stations at 7 p.m. local time and on iHeartRadio’s digital Rumba station at 7 p.m. ET.


**Photos and clips from the livestream can be found**[HERE.](https://iheartradio.photoshelter.com/galleries/C00002qcoMaYcx5g/G0000Y7S2Eh5p2Eo/PR)


Additionally, in honor of **Kirk Franklin’s** new album, I Am What I Am, that was released at midnight ET on Friday, October 30, Kirk Franklin hosted a takeover hour on select iHeartRadio Gospel stations on Sunday, November 1 at 4 p.m. local time featuring both his new songs and past hits.


On October 30, iHeartCountry celebrated **HARDY’s** new single “By God,” with a World Premiere of the new track across iHeartCountry stations nationwide.
